title: Holidays Around the World
text:
People all over the world have special holidays. In Brazil, many people celebrate Carnival in February. They dance, sing and wear colorful costumes. Carnival is a big party in the streets.

In China, people celebrate the New Year in January or February. Families eat dumplings together at this time. Children get red envelopes with money. These envelopes are a gift for good luck.

What do children get during the New Year in China?

options: Family is important during this holiday.

clothes that people wear for a party or show
small pieces of dough filled with food and then cooked

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas em todo o mundo têm feriados especiais. No Brasil, muitas pessoas comemoram o Carnaval em fevereiro. Elas dançam, cantam e usam fantasias coloridas. O Carnaval é uma grande festa nas ruas.

Na China, as pessoas comemoram o Ano Novo em janeiro ou fevereiro. As famílias comem bolinhos juntas nessa época. As crianças recebem envelopes vermelhos com dinheiro. Esses envelopes são um presente de boa sorte.
